items.html: But after it was destroyed, the Mochin of the phase of nursing alone returned to it, and then it is the secret of the exile, and it is not as much wrath as at the time of the destruction, for the judgments are not as great as then, since the VAK are always revealed in it. And through our prayers, we draw down also the Mochin of Gadlut, but only for the moment, as stated regarding the intention of the Shema, for the VAK of nursing are never lacking from it.
